//: versions.yaml is the ONE place a tool version lives. Renovate opens PRs
against it using the regex managers below; nothing else in the repository
should ever be edited to bump a version.
* language runtimes and IaC tools  -> weekly, grouped, minor+patch auto
* security scanners                -> daily, ungrouped, they matter most
* AI CLIs                          -> not managed here; they are channel
pinned in versions.yaml on purpose and refreshed by `devbox update ai`

customManagers.description: Go modules pinned in versions.yaml (comment names the module)

The external base image (a Base Image Factory release) — version and digest move together. THIS is the automated base-update path: the factory publishes ai-engineering-vX.Y.Z, Renovate sees the new tag on the GHCR repo named in base.repo, and opens a PR bumping base.version+base.digest here — which build-devbox.yml then builds and runs the full test suite against before it can merge. Nothing consumes an untested base.

packageRules.description: Security scanners get their own fast lane — a scanner that is a month behind is a scanner that misses the CVE you care about.
IaC toolchain moves together — Terraform, OpenTofu and their linters are used in the same command and are best reviewed as one change.
Kubernetes tooling moves together for the same reason.
Base-image bumps are reviewed individually and labelled — this is the DevBox's foundation changing, and the PR's CI run against the new base is the acceptance gate.
Major bumps are never automatic. Somebody reads the changelog.
GitHub Actions are handled by Dependabot; Renovate stays out of that file to avoid duplicate PRs.
Pre-commit hook revs track the same tools; keep them in step with versions.yaml.
